description_excerpt: Job Description • Lead/Coordinate/Support international engineering teams to work on technical assessment, problem solving, customer approval, tool release as well as implementation of engineering changes • Develops design solutions of electrical connectors for automotive and motorbike applications, taking into account material, manufacturing, ergonomic and economical aspects; assess and validate design, initiate further design improvement. • Performs design calculations including tolerance analysis, functional proof. Utilize designing tools and methodologies such as FMEA, DRBFM, DMFA, etc.…
